props.name: getIsRowDisabled
props.description: Function to determine if a row is disabled. Disabled rows have reduced opacity, show a not-allowed cursor, and cannot be clicked, selected, or expanded.

props.name: getRowLink
props.description: Function to generate a navigation link for a row. When provided, the row renders as a link navigating to the returned URL.

props.name: initiallyExpandAllRows
props.description: When true, all rows are expanded initially. Defaults to false (all collapsed). Overridden by `currentExpanded` when provided.

props.name: currentExpanded
props.description: Current expanded rows state

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Callback for when expanded state changes

props.name: renderSubComponent
props.description: Render function for expanded row content (detail-panel mode). Ignored when `getSubRows` is provided (tree mode).

props.name: getSubRows
props.description: Extract child rows from a data item to enable tree/nested row mode. When provided, expanded rows render their children as indented table rows sharing the same column structure, instead of a detail-panel sub-component.

props.name: enableColumnResizing
props.description: Enable column resizing. Defaults to false. Opt individual columns out with `ColumnDef.enableResizing`, and set initial/min/max widths with `size`, `minSize`, and `maxSize`. Only leaf columns expose resize handles.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Opt-in sticky headers. Renders the table inside a single scroll viewport so header cells stick to the top while the body scrolls. Offsets support up to two stacked header rows (grouped headers).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the table's scroll viewport. Only applies when `stickyHeader` is enabled.

props.name: rowPinning
props.description: Opt-in row pinning state (TanStack `RowPinningState`). Only bottom-pinned rows are rendered: they appear in a `<tfoot>` whose cells stick to the bottom of the scroll viewport (`stickyHeader` is required for sticking). Pin rows by appending them to `data` and listing their `getRowId` ids in `rowPinning.bottom`. Only a single bottom-pinned row is supported — if multiple ids are passed, only the last (bottom-most) row is rendered; without accumulated offsets multiple rows would overlap at `bottom: 0`. `keepPinnedRows` is left at its default (`true`), so pinned rows survive pagination and filtering.

props.name: onRowPinningChange
props.description: Callback for when row pinning changes.

props.name: enableRowPinning
props.description: Whether rows can be pinned. See TanStack `enableRowPinning`.
